contentPattern.rows: One row per gallery / pack tile.
cells: Count badge text, e.g. "13 Images" or "7 Videos"
Text: optional date paragraph, heading (title linked to the gallery), optional teaser, optional "Download" link

usage.description: Image-pack and video-pack rails and listings: album tiles with an image-count badge linking to the full gallery.

reuseGuidance: Use for pack/album tiles that need a count badge. Default has a dark badge; alt is for tiles on a dark section (light text); alt-2 uses the light translucent badge of the home-page Images/Videos rails. For plain article cards use cards-news.
designReference: Values lifted from stardust/prototypes (canon/modules.css and per-page css) where a counterpart exists.
